description: Create a UPI payment link (upi://pay) for an Indian UPI ID. On a phone it opens PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM or any UPI app with the payee, amount and note filled in. Use it to collect a payment, split a bill or put on an invoice. Returns the link and a proupiqr.in page with its QR code and printable poster. Amounts are exact to the paisa; nothing is stored. It never moves money: the payer approves the payment in their own UPI app.

amount.description: Optional amount in rupees, e.g. 499 or "1250.50". Leave it out and the payer types the amount.

note.description: Optional note shown to the payer and on statements, e.g. "Invoice 42". Up to 80 characters.

payee_name.description: Name the payer's UPI app shows: the shop, business or person.

upi_id.description: Payee UPI ID (VPA), e.g. ramesh@okaxis or 9876543210@ybl.

name: create_upi_payment_link
title: Create UPI payment link
